description.value: An off-grid outdoor learning centre and retreat facility on Powell Lake, at the junction of the Sunshine Coast Trail and the Powell Forest Canoe Route. The centre offers cabin accommodations for up to 60 overnight guests, with catered meals and a wide range of guided outdoor activities including hiking, canoeing, and kayaking. It primarily hosts school groups, weddings, and corporate retreats, though individual adventurers are also welcomed.

address.value: C/O School District 47, 4351 Ontario Avenue, Powell River, BC V8A 1V3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website describes a group-oriented outdoor learning centre on Powell Lake, 15 minutes by car from Powell River, operating completely off-grid. It accommodates up to 60 overnight guests in cabins and primarily serves school groups, weddings, and corporate retreats. The 'For Travellers' section suggests individual adventurers may also be welcomed. There is zero mention of cycling or bike storage anywhere on the site. The FAQ confirms catering provides meals three times a day and trip food to go. OSM tags are minimal (building=yes, tourism=alpine_hut) and provide no amenity detail.
